ja: 通話中ずっと途切れていたのは、回線じゃなくてそちらの音声だったんですよ。
en: It was your audio, not the connection, that kept cutting out during the call.
alternatives: What kept cutting out during the call was your audio, not the connection.
It was your audio that kept cutting out during the call, not the connection.
point: 強調したい語を It was と that で挟む

ja: 受付の方は、田中さんは会議中なので30分後にかけ直してもらえないかと言っていました。
en: The receptionist said Mr. Tanaka was in a meeting and asked if I could call back in thirty minutes.
alternatives: The receptionist told me Mr. Tanaka was in a meeting and asked me to call back in thirty minutes.
The receptionist said Ms. Tanaka was in a meeting and asked if I could call back in half an hour.
point: said に合わせて is を was、can を could にずらす

ja: 昨日の会議ではそちらの音声が何度も途切れていましたが、あれから別のヘッドセットに替えましたか？
en: Your audio kept cutting out in yesterday's meeting. Have you switched to a different headset since then?
alternatives: Your audio kept dropping out in yesterday's meeting. Have you gotten a different headset since then?
Your audio kept breaking up in yesterday's meeting. Have you switched to another headset since then?
point: 昨日の出来事は過去形、あれからの変化は現在完了

ja: 田中さん、マイクがミュートになっていますよ。もう一度言ってください。
en: Mr. Tanaka, you're on mute. Please say that again.
alternatives: Mr. Tanaka, you're muted. Please say it again.
Mr. Tanaka, you're on mute. Could you say that again?
point: ミュート中は you're on mute が定番の言い方

ja: すみません、今は運転中なので、あとでかけ直します。
en: Sorry, I'm driving now. I'll call back later.
alternatives: Sorry, I'm driving right now, so I'll call you back later.
Sorry, I'm driving right now. I'll call you later.
point: 今している最中のことは I'm driving と進行形で言う

ja: この回線、少し雑音がありますね。
en: There's some noise on this line.
alternatives: There's a little noise on this line.
There is some noise on the line.
point: 「雑音がある」は There's some noise で、noise は数えない
